Hero_Desc_Ayla:
The guardian of the central volcanic island beyond the continent of Elias.
She is normally easygoing and relaxed, but becomes terrifying once she erupts.
Recently, she has been training her mind and striving to control her temper.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Ayla: Guardian of Peace on the Volcanic Island
Album_Wish_Ayla: To nap forever in warm weather
Album_Ayla1: Having come from Volcanica, Ayla finds everything in Elias fascinating and fun. Monatium is her favorite place of all. ...Come to think of it, perhaps she simply likes internet cafes...?
Album_Ayla2: Ayla has grown quite close to the Elementals of Elias, receiving advice from them and sometimes joining their gatherings. Seeing her form friendships not only with Elementals but with many other races made me strangely proud.
Album_Ayla3: I went to Elemental Mountain to visit Ayla, who had settled nicely into life in Elias, only to find someone who looked as though she had not bathed in days. Beside her was a mountain of comic books and empty snack bags. I did not need to ask what she had been doing.
Album_Ayla4: When Ayla came to the banquet hall asking for a boxed lunch, I asked what she needed it for. She said she was going stargazing with Gabia. When I asked whether any other Apostles were joining them, she said they had already invited a tiny Dragon as well.
Album_Ayla5: Recently, Delia and Ayla became hooked on dessert tours through the Sprite shopping district. As a result, they ate so many desserts from the Sprite Kingdom that they gained a little weight. No, quite a lot. Guin dragged them away to exercise. Good luck, you two.
Album_Ayla6: Ayla has been visiting Monatium often lately. When I asked whether she was going to an internet cafe, she said she was practicing exercises for meditation. Unfortunately, the exercises sometimes make her feelings boil even more fiercely. It seems Asana's yoga is still difficult for her.
Album_Ayla7: One day, a letter arrived from Ayla after she returned to Volcanica. It was an invitation telling me to visit whenever I needed somewhere to rest. The warmth filling every line of her letter made it a wonderful day.
LoveHero_Ayla: All right, new friends are always welcome!
LoveHeroCancel_Ayla: I am a little disappointed... Please come find me again next time.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Hate1: She became furious, declaring that calling this food was an insult to food itself. Then the space ration burned to ashes before my eyes...
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Hate2: Saying she had not eaten a pomegranate in ages, she took an enormous bite, then became angry that it nearly broke her teeth. Its pomegranate-like appearance fooled her.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like1: She said she had missed the fresh scent of the sea, chewing every bite thoroughly and savoring the flavor.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like2: She was amazed by the idea of steeping fruit in warm water instead of making it into cool juice. She seemed to like it, blowing gently and continuing to drink.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like3: She praised the soup and repeatedly asked for more broth. Did she not say at first that she preferred the chewy rice cakes...?
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like4: At first, she became angry and asked how anyone could eat a tree. After one bite, she attacked it eagerly with her fork, then suggested making it palm-tree shaped next time. That would no longer be a buche de Noel...
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like5: Finding it was not even sour, she tossed it all into her mouth and asked for more, saying she felt energized. Since then, she has visited from time to time to carry off piles of Tart Vita F.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like6: After eating several, she asked for only the honey-filled songpyeon so she could pick out her favorites. She looked disappointed when I told her that was obviously not allowed.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like7: She praised the well-made chocolate and savored it in her mouth for a long time. Reluctantly deciding to save the rest, she wrapped it carefully and took it away.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like8: She complained that eating one had kept her awake all night, then asked for another. Apparently, she was going out to play with Gabia that night.
Food_ChefNote_Ayla_Like9: She asked whether there was a tropical fruit flavor and was delighted when she found one. Saying each color tasted different, she spent the entire day eating candy and guessing which fruits had been used.

LoveLetter_Ayla:
Hello!

These days, I have gotten used to visiting the Order with Gabia. I heard it was a little cooler than the island I manage, but this is still a perfectly fine place for sunbathing.

Thanks to you coming to find me, Master, I have met more Elementals, and that makes me happy. I cannot always remain near the Order because I need to manage the island... but I hope to meet many more Elementals in the future.

I will always keep a room free, so whether you come alone or with a group, visit Volcanica whenever you want somewhere quiet to rest!
LoveCall_Ayla:
Master! Have you been well?
Volcanica is the same as ever! Sleepy, peaceful, and warm!
You do not have to think about anything. You can simply nap!

But... I have actually been worried lately.
This has never happened before, but all sorts of thoughts keep coming to me and make it difficult to fall asleep.

I heard that the place where you live is rather different from our island.
Especially that you have more work than you can handle.
Perhaps that is why I keep wondering how you are doing.
Whether all that work is exhausting you, and whether you are getting proper naps.
There seemed to be quite a few troublesome people too... Do you handle everything by yourself, Master?
Sigh... You might think I am worrying over nothing, but I cannot help thinking about it.

I wish I were not so far away and could help you...
It would be wonderful if you came to live with me on our island.
But you have friends you must protect as well, so I suppose it cannot be helped.
I understand how you feel, Master! So tell me everything whenever things become difficult!
Mmm~ When will I see you again? I miss you, Master!
Affinity_Ayla_EP01_001: There are so many fascinating things here.
Affinity_Ayla_EP01_002: You are the most fascinating of all.
Affinity_Ayla_EP01_003: That sounds rather rude. I can feel myself beginning to boil... Huh, why are you so startled? Naturally, I was joking.
Affinity_Ayla_EP01_005: Yes. Delia showed me around, so I had an enjoyable time. But there are still many places I have not seen.
Affinity_Ayla_EP01_006: It was entertaining, was it not?
Affinity_Ayla_EP01_007: Entertaining...? There were so many fascinating things that I stared at them and lost track of time. Hmm~ Now that I think about it, it was entertaining.
Affinity_Ayla_EP02_001: Do you have a specialty dish, Master? I would like that~
Affinity_Ayla_EP02_003: There are so many kinds of bread. I cannot finish all of this~ Give me a reasonable amount~
Affinity_Ayla_EP02_004: I will give you something fascinating: space rations!
Affinity_Ayla_EP02_005: Th-This... feels like chewing sand... I do not think such a thing should be called food! What? It truly is food?!
Affinity_Ayla_EP02_006: Behold a dish from my homeland!
Affinity_Ayla_EP02_007: Oh... Ohh! What a fascinating flavor! I would like another bowl!!
Affinity_Ayla_EP03_001: ...This place has more troublesome people than I expected.
Affinity_Ayla_EP03_003: Was there another Elemental in Volcanica...? I am the only one! Are you saying I am troublesome? Hmm... Then I am sorry. I will be more careful.
Affinity_Ayla_EP03_004: Even so... they are good people.
Affinity_Ayla_EP03_005: Some of them take their pranks too far... but I admit they are kind at heart.
Affinity_Ayla_EP03_007: I-Is that enough to make you cry?! D-Do not cry, Master. Would you... like some fruit from Volcanica?
Affinity_Ayla_EP04_001: Hmm? I saw something rather fascinating~
Affinity_Ayla_EP04_003: I often see enormous ships. Volcanica is an island where travelers stop to rest.
Affinity_Ayla_EP04_004: What was it? Something Volcanica does not have?
Affinity_Ayla_EP04_005: I saw all sorts of sparkling objects in a PC cafe. They were truly fascinating!
Affinity_Ayla_EP04_006: I cannot even begin to guess what they were.
Affinity_Ayla_EP04_007: Hehe. They must be ordinary to you, Master. If you are curious, I will tell you about them!
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_001: You are adding that much seasoning...? Do not blame me if it tastes strange~
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_002: Food is all about the seasoning!
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_003: Confidence is good, but... Hmm~ Let me taste it... Ugh, that is far too much seasoning for me. Please use a moderate amount next time.
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_004: If it is not sweet, it is not food.
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_005: I do not like sweetness made by adding nothing but piles of sugar! And sweetness alone does not make everything delicious!
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_006: Do not worry. Everything is proceeding according to plan.
Affinity_Ayla_EP05_007: Hmm...? I-Is that so? Then let me try a bite... Oh? This is rather delicious. How unexpected.
Affinity_Ayla_EP06_001: The fruit here seems somewhat less sweet than the fruit in Volcanica.
Affinity_Ayla_EP06_002: I want to eat Volcanican fruit again...
Affinity_Ayla_EP06_003: Really? Then I will bring some fruit next time. Hearing that you like it makes me happy too.
Affinity_Ayla_EP06_004: Should we feed the trees sugar water?
Affinity_Ayla_EP06_005: Why would you torment the trees...? I doubt that would make their fruit sweeter... Please do not.
Affinity_Ayla_EP06_007: Exactly. The sunlight is wonderful, the air is pleasant... Volcanica truly is the best.
Affinity_Ayla_EP07_001: Do I ever frighten you, Master? Hmm? It is not that I care greatly... I was merely curious.
Affinity_Ayla_EP07_002: Do not worry so much about what others say.
Affinity_Ayla_EP07_003: That would be best... but sometimes, it still troubles me. Sigh... What should I do at times like that?
Affinity_Ayla_EP07_004: It is fine because I know you are kind and good.
Affinity_Ayla_EP07_005: R-Really? Hearing you say that is somewhat embarrassing. Thank you for the compliment.
Affinity_Ayla_EP07_007: Ugh... I try not to become angry... but I cannot always control it.
Affinity_Ayla_EP08_001: I met a High Elemental of Water... and could not even summon the energy to become angry...
Affinity_Ayla_EP08_002: Because you are incompatible with water?
Affinity_Ayla_EP08_003: Um... We are incompatible, but that is not what I meant. She was incredibly... incredibly... energetic... fond of pranks... innocent... Hmm...
Affinity_Ayla_EP08_005: 'Too'...? Master, did she get you as well? Haha... I nearly became angry for the first time in ages.
Affinity_Ayla_EP08_007: Still, she seemed kind. The moment I began to grow angry, she noticed and apologized.
Affinity_Ayla_EP09_002: I want to take a nap too.
Affinity_Ayla_EP09_003: Huh? Do you have too much work? Then I will help you~ You need only ask!
Affinity_Ayla_EP09_005: What is wrong with naps?! Napping is one of my hobbies. Do not disturb me.
Affinity_Ayla_EP09_006: I have an excellent pillow for napping.
Affinity_Ayla_EP09_007: Th-This is!! It has precisely the right balance of softness and support! Where did you find it? I would like one... No, two more!
Affinity_Ayla_EP10_001: I heard nothing surpasses yoga for mastering one's inner self, so I went to learn it. Hmm... But...
Affinity_Ayla_EP10_002: Nothing beats pine-needle juice after yoga.
Affinity_Ayla_EP10_003: Ugh... I already drank some... My mouth still tastes of pine... Could you give me fruit juice? I need something to wash it away.
Affinity_Ayla_EP10_005: The movements themselves were not too difficult. But I performed a pose called Savasana and fell asleep.
Affinity_Ayla_EP10_006: When you work up a sweat, stray thoughts disappear.
Affinity_Ayla_EP10_007: That certainly was true. The strange poses gave me no time to think, and they were exhausting.
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_001: What should I do when calming my heart feels utterly impossible?
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_002: Food is best. Come here, eat something delicious, and then go!
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_003: Hmm? I doubt food alone can calm my heart. But it is delicious!
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_004: Why not lie down upon the ground first?
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_005: That must be it! Listening to the earth as Gabia taught me will surely be most effective!
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_006: Let all your anger erupt at once, then cast it away!
Affinity_Ayla_EP11_007: Huh? Master! Think before you speak! I never want to cause another catastrophic eruption!
Affinity_Ayla_EP12_001: I heard the Lower Elementals here are afflicted by labor... Is that true?
Affinity_Ayla_EP12_002: They work in exchange for appropriate compensation!
Affinity_Ayla_EP12_003: Those words are difficult... In any case, work does not look pleasant. Perhaps it is fine if the Elementals are happy?
Affinity_Ayla_EP12_005: Master... Our views are completely different. In Volcanica, everyone can enjoy everything without doing a thing!
Affinity_Ayla_EP12_006: Some Elementals help one another and restore their strength in the process.
Affinity_Ayla_EP12_007: Hmm~? Restoring themselves by using their own abilities... Everyone has a different way of resting!
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_001: Does Gabia visit here often? What does she usually eat?
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_002: Gabia does not visit very often...
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_003: Hmm~? Does Gabia dislike this place? There must be a reason!
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_004: She tends to enjoy food resembling earth.
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_005: Yes, yes~ Precisely what I expected~ Give me the same thing!
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_006: What was it...? I think she ate most things without complaint.
Affinity_Ayla_EP13_007: As expected of Gabia! She is not picky about food... How mature! I should learn from her.
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_001: Where does my jellyfish friend live? I am curious what sort of place it is!
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_002: Where she lives...? Would a PC cafe be the correct answer?
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_003: Huh? I have heard enough about PC cafes to wear out my ears! Why does my jellyfish friend like them so much?
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_004: She lives with me at the Order. For now, at least.
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_005: Master, were you close enough to my jellyfish friend to live together? That is rather unexpected...
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_006: It is difficult to define what 'home' means for Bella.
Affinity_Ayla_EP14_007: As expected of my jellyfish friend... She always defies my expectations. Such freedom seems pleasant too!
Affinity_Ayla_EP15_001: How many friends do you have, Master?
Affinity_Ayla_EP15_002: The number does not matter. You need only understand one another.
Affinity_Ayla_EP15_003: Exactly! Even a single friend is precious. You and I understand each other, Master, so we are good friends!
Affinity_Ayla_EP15_004: You can consider everyone you have seen here my friend.
Affinity_Ayla_EP15_005: Th-That many? You are a master at making friends. I envy you!
Affinity_Ayla_EP15_007: H-Huh? They are acquaintances, not friends? Hmm... Your standard for friendship is exceptionally high.
Affinity_Ayla_EP16_001: I want to eat something piping hot...
Affinity_Ayla_EP16_002: Shall I heat some warm porridge for you?
Affinity_Ayla_EP16_003: I have never tried it... but I like the thought of it warming me from within!

Affinity_Ayla_EP17_001: What kind of place is paradise to you, Master?
Affinity_Ayla_EP17_002: Somewhere I can eat and play without working?
Affinity_Ayla_EP17_003: Hmm! I think so too. Then Volcanica is paradise for you, Master~
Affinity_Ayla_EP17_004: A prosperous land overflowing with gold and treasure!
Affinity_Ayla_EP17_005: Ugh... You sound like a pirate. I thought you would be different, Master. How disappointing!
Affinity_Ayla_EP17_006: Somewhere I can live peacefully with my friends.
Affinity_Ayla_EP17_007: Hmm? You are deeply thoughtful, Master. I hope our island can become such a place!
Affinity_Ayla_EP18_001: I visited the land where Gabia lives. Something about it was...
Affinity_Ayla_EP18_003: 'Gloomy' is not a pleasant description! It was somewhat cold, but the earth was soft and comforting.
Affinity_Ayla_EP18_004: It does not sound like a place that suits you.
Affinity_Ayla_EP18_005: Hmm... There are many kinds of earth. Anywhere Gabia lives is fine with me.
Affinity_Ayla_EP18_006: What sort of place was it again...?
Affinity_Ayla_EP18_007: Huh? I heard you visited often too... Do you have no interest in the earth at all, Master?
Affinity_Ayla_EP19_001: When I return to Volcanica, I am thinking of reorganizing the island...
Affinity_Ayla_EP19_002: I look forward to it! Invite me next time.
Affinity_Ayla_EP19_003: Of course! I will invite every friend I made in Elias! I hope it becomes an island where everyone can enjoy themselves happily.
Affinity_Ayla_EP19_005: H-Huh? What do you mean? It is my island, so of course I can! Master, do you think I am unfit to manage it?!
Affinity_Ayla_EP19_006: Oh~ Are you building a PC cafe resort?
Affinity_Ayla_EP19_007: I had not planned to... but I will consider it if you want one. My jellyfish friend, you... Does everyone enjoy PC cafes?
Affinity_Ayla_EP20_001: Can I become good friends with everyone on the island?
Affinity_Ayla_EP20_003: Hmm? Do not answer so carelessly! I would like a more serious answer!
Affinity_Ayla_EP20_004: I think you will do well, Ayla.
Affinity_Ayla_EP20_005: Master... Thank you! I must work harder so I do not disappoint everyone. Somehow, I feel energized!
Affinity_Ayla_EP20_006: Your results will reflect the effort you invest.
Affinity_Ayla_EP20_007: Every day, I listen to the earth and try to calm my heart! But it is still difficult... Gabia truly is remarkable...
